dict.string: Bytt systemets lydutgang mellom hodetelefoner+BlackHole og MacBook-høyttalere+BlackHole (for å ta opp systemlyd samtidig som du hører den)
Bytt systemutgang til BQCE (uten BlackHole, normal volumkontroll)
Bytt systemutgang til MacBook Pro-høyttalere (uten BlackHole, normal volumkontroll)
Tar opp systemlyd (BlackHole 2ch) og mikrofon, mikset til én WAV i ~/Downloads

readonly pid_file="${alfred_workflow_data}/recording.pid" readonly mic_pid_file="${alfred_workflow_data}/mic.pid" readonly parts_dir="${alfred_workflow_data}/parts" mkdir -p "${parts_dir}"
if [[ -f "${pid_file}" ]] && kill -0 "$(< "${pid_file}")" 2>/dev/null; then osascript -e 'display notification "Opptak pågår allerede" with title "BlackHole"' exit 0 fi rm -f "${pid_file}" "${mic_pid_file}"
# Husk hva som var aktiv utgang, så stopp kan sette den tilbake. /opt/homebrew/bin/SwitchAudioSource -c > "${alfred_workflow_data}/previous_output.txt"
# Velg kombo etter hva som er koblet til: jack > Bluetooth (BQCE) > høyttalere. readonly outputs="$(/opt/homebrew/bin/SwitchAudioSource -a -t output)" if grep -qx "Eksterne hodetelefoner" <<< "${outputs}"; then /opt/homebrew/bin/SwitchAudioSource -s "Jack+BlackHole" elif grep -qx "BQCE" <<< "${outputs}"; then /opt/homebrew/bin/SwitchAudioSource -s "Hodetelefoner+BlackHole" else /opt/homebrew/bin/SwitchAudioSource -s "MacBook+BlackHole" fi
sleep 0.5
readonly stamp="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)" readonly outfile="${HOME}/Downloads/${stamp}.wav"
# To sox-prosesser: én på BlackHole 2ch (systemlyd = den andre parten) og én på "default" # (systemets standard mikrofon = deg, uansett om det er MacBook-mik eller headset). BlackHole # får bare det som spilles av, så uten mikrofonsporet mangler din egen stemme (2026-09-24). # Delfilene ligger i parts/ og mikses til én WAV i ~/Downloads når opptaket stoppes. # # Opptak med sox (CoreAudio direkte). ffmpeg/avfoundation holder bare én lydbuffer i kø og # mister samples så snart den ikke rekker å lese (12 % i ro, 74 % under whisper-last # 2026-09-23) – opptaket ble kortere enn sanntid og hørtes "for kjapt" ut. sox har ringbuffer. # Kjøres som engangsjobber i launchd (KeepAlive=false): da er launchd "ansvarlig prosess" # for TCC/mikrofon (som barn av Alfred blir opptakeren drept av TCC), og ingenting restarter # jobben når den avslutter – i motsetning til `launchctl submit`, som overskrev opptaket # 2026-09-23. start_job() { local label="$1" device="$2" channels="$3" file="$4" local job_plist="${alfred_workflow_data}/${label}.plist" local log_file="${alfred_workflow_data}/${label#com.simonetnan.}.log" launchctl bootout "gui/$(id -u)/${label}" 2>/dev/null cat > "${job_plist}" <<PLIST <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd"> <plist version="1.0"><dict> <key>Label</key><string>${label}</string> <key>ProgramArguments</key><array> <string>/opt/homebrew/bin/sox</string><string>-q</string> <string>-t</string><string>coreaudio</string><string>${device}</string> <string>-r</string><string>44100</string><string>-b</string><string>16</string><string>-c</string><string>${channels}</string> <string>${file}</string> </array> <key>RunAtLoad</key><true/> <key>KeepAlive</key><false/> <key>StandardOutPath</key><string>${log_file}</string> <key>StandardErrorPath</key><string>${log_file}</string> </dict></plist> PLIST launchctl bootstrap "gui/$(id -u)" "${job_plist}" }
job_pid() { launchctl print "gui/$(id -u)/$1" 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 -E '^\s*pid = ' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' }
# Start begge før vi venter, så sporene starter så likt som mulig. start_job com.simonetnan.blackhole-recording "BlackHole 2ch" 2 "${parts_dir}/${stamp}-system.wav" start_job com.simonetnan.mic-recording default 1 "${parts_dir}/${stamp}-mic.wav" sleep 1
readonly sys_pid="$(job_pid com.simonetnan.blackhole-recording)" readonly mic_pid="$(job_pid com.simonetnan.mic-recording)" if [[ -z "${sys_pid}" ]]; then [[ -n "${mic_pid}" ]] && kill -INT "${mic_pid}" osascript -e 'display notification "Klarte ikke starte sox – se blackhole-recording.log" with title "BlackHole"' exit 1 fi echo "${sys_pid}" > "${pid_file}" echo "${outfile}" > "${alfred_workflow_data}/last_recording.txt"
if [[ -n "${mic_pid}" ]]; then echo "${mic_pid}" > "${mic_pid_file}" osascript -e "display notification \"${outfile##*/} (systemlyd + mikrofon)\" with title \"Opptak startet\"" else osascript -e "display notification \"${outfile##*/} – mikrofon startet ikke, se mic-recording.log\" with title \"Opptak startet (bare systemlyd)\"" fi
Stopper pågående opptak og lagrer WAV-filen i ~/Downloads

readonly pid_file="${alfred_workflow_data}/recording.pid" readonly mic_pid_file="${alfred_workflow_data}/mic.pid" readonly parts_dir="${alfred_workflow_data}/parts" readonly mix_log="${alfred_workflow_data}/mix.log"
restore_output() { local outputs previous outputs="$(/opt/homebrew/bin/SwitchAudioSource -a -t output)" previous="$(< "${alfred_workflow_data}/previous_output.txt" 2>/dev/null)" if [[ -n "${previous}" ]] && grep -qxF "${previous}" <<< "${outputs}"; then /opt/homebrew/bin/SwitchAudioSource -s "${previous}" elif grep -qx "Eksterne hodetelefoner" <<< "${outputs}"; then /opt/homebrew/bin/SwitchAudioSource -s "Eksterne hodetelefoner" elif grep -qx "BQCE" <<< "${outputs}"; then /opt/homebrew/bin/SwitchAudioSource -s "BQCE" else /opt/homebrew/bin/SwitchAudioSource -s "MacBook Pro-høyttalere" fi }
# Vent til prosessen er borte; TERM som siste utvei. wait_gone() { local pid="$1" [[ -n "${pid}" ]] || return 0 for i in {1..50}; do kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || return 0 sleep 0.2 done kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null sleep 1 }
if [[ ! -f "${pid_file}" ]] || ! kill -0 "$(< "${pid_file}")" 2>/dev/null; then rm -f "${pid_file}" "${mic_pid_file}" restore_output osascript -e 'display notification "Ingen aktivt opptak – lydutgang satt tilbake" with title "BlackHole"' exit 0 fi
readonly sys_pid="$(< "${pid_file}")" readonly mic_pid="$(< "${mic_pid_file}" 2>/dev/null)"
# Ctrl-C lar sox skrive ferdig WAV-headeren. Send til begge først, vent etterpå. kill -INT "${sys_pid}" 2>/dev/null [[ -n "${mic_pid}" ]] && kill -INT "${mic_pid}" 2>/dev/null wait_gone "${sys_pid}" wait_gone "${mic_pid}"
rm -f "${pid_file}" "${mic_pid_file}" launchctl bootout "gui/$(id -u)/com.simonetnan.blackhole-recording" 2>/dev/null launchctl bootout "gui/$(id -u)/com.simonetnan.mic-recording" 2>/dev/null
restore_output
readonly outfile="$(< "${alfred_workflow_data}/last_recording.txt" 2>/dev/null)" readonly base="${outfile##*/}" readonly stamp="${base%.wav}" readonly sys_part="${parts_dir}/${stamp}-system.wav" readonly mic_part="${parts_dir}/${stamp}-mic.wav"
# Miks systemlyd (stereo) og mikrofon (mono → dupliseres til begge kanaler) til én fil. # `-m` skalerer hver kilde med 1/n, `gain -n -1` normaliserer toppen til -1 dBFS etterpå. # Delfilene slettes bare når miksen lyktes; feiler den, flyttes systemsporet til Downloads. osascript -e "display notification \"${base}\" with title \"Mikser opptak…\"" if [[ -s "${mic_part}" ]] && /opt/homebrew/bin/sox -m "${sys_part}" "|/opt/homebrew/bin/sox \"${mic_part}\" -p channels 2" "${outfile}" gain -n -1 2>> "${mix_log}"; then rm -f "${sys_part}" "${mic_part}" readonly what="systemlyd + mikrofon" elif mv "${sys_part}" "${outfile}" 2>> "${mix_log}"; then readonly what="bare systemlyd – miks feilet, se mix.log" else osascript -e 'display notification "Fant ikke opptaket – se mix.log" with title "Opptak feilet"' exit 1 fi
readonly secs="$(/opt/homebrew/bin/ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "${outfile}" 2>/dev/null | cut -d. -f1)" osascript -e "display notification \"${base} (${secs:-?} s, ${what})\" with title \"Opptak lagret\""
Transkriberer nyeste lydfil i Downloads til norsk tekst

readonly lang="no" readonly model="${HOME}/.whisper-models/ggml-nb-whisper-large.bin" readonly workdir="${alfred_workflow_data}" readonly script_file="${workdir}/transcribe_no.sh" readonly pid_file="${workdir}/transcribe.pid" mkdir -p "${workdir}"
if [[ -f "${pid_file}" ]] && kill -0 "$(< "${pid_file}")" 2>/dev/null; then osascript -e 'display notification "En transkribering kjører allerede" with title "Transkribering"' exit 0 fi
readonly src="$(find "${HOME}/Downloads" -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -iname '*.wav' -o -iname '*.m4a' -o -iname '*.mp3' -o -iname '*.aac' \) -exec stat -f '%m %N' {} \; | sort -rn | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2-)"
if [[ -z "${src}" ]]; then osascript -e 'display notification "Fant ingen lydfil i Downloads" with title "Transkribering"' exit 0 fi
cat > "${script_file}" <<SCRIPT #!/bin/zsh src="${src}" lang="${lang}" model="${model}" base="\${src:t:r}" wav16="${workdir}/\${base}-16k.wav" outbase="${HOME}/Downloads/\${base}"
/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg -y -i "\${src}" -ar 16000 -ac 1 "\${wav16}" /opt/homebrew/bin/whisper-cli -m "\${model}" -f "\${wav16}" -l "\${lang}" -otxt -of "\${outbase}" rc=\$? rm -f "\${wav16}" "${pid_file}" if [[ \$rc -eq 0 ]]; then osascript -e "display notification \"\${base}.txt\" with title \"Transkribering ferdig (\${lang})\"" else osascript -e "display notification \"whisper feilet (kode \$rc), se transcribe.log\" with title \"Transkribering\"" fi SCRIPT chmod +x "${script_file}"
# Kjøres direkte i bakgrunnen (ikke launchctl submit – launchd restartet jobben i loop). # Engangsjobb i launchd (KeepAlive=false) – ikke `launchctl submit`, som restartet i loop. readonly label="com.simonetnan.transcribe-no" readonly job_plist="${workdir}/${label}.plist" launchctl bootout "gui/$(id -u)/${label}" 2>/dev/null cat > "${job_plist}" <<PLIST <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd"> <plist version="1.0"><dict> <key>Label</key><string>${label}</string> <key>ProgramArguments</key><array><string>/bin/zsh</string><string>${script_file}</string></array> <key>RunAtLoad</key><true/> <key>KeepAlive</key><false/> <key>StandardOutPath</key><string>${workdir}/transcribe.log</string> <key>StandardErrorPath</key><string>${workdir}/transcribe.log</string> </dict></plist> PLIST launchctl bootstrap "gui/$(id -u)" "${job_plist}" sleep 0.5 launchctl print "gui/$(id -u)/${label}" 2>/dev/null | grep -m1 -E '^\s*pid = ' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' > "${pid_file}"
osascript -e "display notification \"$(basename "${src}")\" with title \"Transkribering startet (no)\""

Bytt systemutgang til kablede hodetelefoner (jack) + BlackHole 2ch
Bytt systemutgang til kablede hodetelefoner (uten BlackHole, normal volumkontroll)

Krever switchaudio-osx (brew install switchaudio-osx), sox og Multi-Output-enheter satt opp i Audio MIDI Setup ('Hodetelefoner+BlackHole', 'MacBook+BlackHole', 'Jack+BlackHole'), alle med BlackHole 2ch inkludert. Opptak tar opp BlackHole (systemlyd) og standard mikrofon i to sox-jobber under launchd og mikser dem ved stopp.
